title: Scorer Factory and Task Benchmarks for Quant Profile Quality
creator: Lena Cho
description: Build a pluggable 'scorer factory' and a set of canonical task benchmarks to validate accuracy regressions introduced by FP8/INT8 quantization profiles. This ticket covers metric implementation rules (perplexity normalization, MMLU-style aggregated scoring, ROUGE/BLEU tokenization policy), task-specific scorers (QA F1, extractive/abstractive summarization, translation, code exact-match/exec), and integration with the calibration workflow so gates can be applied to rollout decisions.
acceptance_criteria: A scorer factory library exists in /evaluation/scorers and can instantiate metric chains from a JSON contract
Perplexity implementation matches reference float baseline on the test harness (within configured tolerance) after log-prob correction for sequence-length/batch effects
MMLU-style suite runner produces aggregated accuracy and per-subtask breakdowns and supports task weighting in the calibration pipeline
ROUGE and BLEU implementations follow the normalization/tokenization rules documented in the confluence page and support detokenized and subword-aware modes
Task-specific scorers: QA F1, ROUGE-L for summarization, BLEU for translation, and code exact-match + simple execution sandbox are implemented and have unit tests
Scorers are pluggable into the calibration pipeline so quant profile candidate runs generate an evaluation artifact (JSON) with metric vectors and a pass/fail gate
CI smoke tests run for INT8/FP8 run artifacts and validate metric computation deterministic seeds where applicable
Documentation and examples (Confluence + example notebooks) exist for how to add a new task scorer
design_notes: We will expose a ScorerFactory that composes primitive scorers (token_prob, ngram_overlap, exact_match, execution_check) into task scorers via declarative contracts.

Perplexity: use token-logprob aggregation with temperature-aware normalization. For streaming outputs where probabilities are approximated, apply a correction term derived from kernel-level confidence metadata (provided by the runtime).

MMLU: provide both micro-accuracy and a hierarchical aggregated macro score that supports task weighting and missing-subtask handling. Export per-subtask confusion matrices for calibration diagnostics.

ROUGE/BLEU: standardize on detokenized comparisons with optional subword-merging. Quantization-induced whitespace/tokenization shifts must be neutralized by a normalization preprocessor that maps model tokenizer tokens back to text tokens before scoring.

Code scoring: primary metric = exact-match on canonicalized AST for small snippets; secondary metric = execution pass rate in a restricted Python sandbox with resource/time limits. Avoid heavyweight execution for CI; provide optional extended runs in nightly pipelines.

Trade-offs: stronger metrics (exec-based code scoring, strict exact-match) are more costly and brittle to non-semantic differences; we provide layered scoring (fast approximate in PRs, heavier verification in nightly/regression runs).
Backward compatibility: scorer contracts are versioned. Older calibration artifacts must remain interpretable by newer scorer factory instances.

Privacy: datasets for customer-sensitive tasks must be referenced by S3 asset IDs and accessed through vaulted credentials. The scorer library will refuse to persist raw examples in evaluation artifacts unless explicitly allowed by flag.
Determinism: quantized kernels may produce non-deterministic float pathways. Scorers should accept seeds and a 'stability_tolerance' parameter used by the gating logic in calibration.

Performance: metric computation should be vectorized and support batch evaluation; provide async streaming scorer that can handle token-stream outputs from the runtime without blocking the serving path.
implementation_plan: Week 1: Define metric contract schema, scorer factory API, and normalize tokenization policy doc (Confluence link in links)
Week 2: Implement perplexity scorer with token-prob normalization and unit tests; integrate into CI smoke suite
Week 3: Implement MMLU-suite runner and per-subtask reporting; add export to calibration artifact format
Week 4: Implement ROUGE/BLEU scorers with detokenization pipeline and subword options; add fast-approx mode for PRs
Week 5: Implement task-specific scorers (QA F1, summarization ROUGE-L, translation BLEU, code exact/exec) and small execution sandbox harness
Week 6: Integrate scorers into calibration workflow: scoring step generates metric vectors, applies gating rules, and writes verdict to evaluations store
Week 7: End-to-end tests: run a set of quant profile candidates (FP8 baseline, INT8 baseline, hybrid) and verify expected metric deltas and gating behavior; address edge cases
Post-merge: Add notebook examples and update Console's quality dashboard ingestion spec
progress_updates: 2025-02-12: Kickoff meeting with ML infra, runtime, and QA. Agreed on single scorer contract schema and a shared confluence doc template (see links).
2025-02-17: Perplexity scorer prototype merged to feature branch. Initial tests show consistent bias vs float baseline that is explained by tokenization differences; normalization rule added.
2025-02-21: MMLU runner prototype completed. Early runs show consistent 0.6-1.2% degradation on INT8 in synthetic suite; added per-subtask logs for triage.
2025-02-26: ROUGE detokenization policy updated after design review — we now run both detokenized and subword-merged modes and record both scores.
2025-03-02: Code scoring sandbox implemented with resource caps; CI uses canonicalized AST exact-match for PRs and nightly pipeline runs execution checks.
2025-03-04: ScorerFactory API review scheduled with runtime team next week to add kernel confidence metadata hook.
review_feedback: PM (Aisha Patel): Request to expose 'weighting presets' for known enterprise-sensitive tasks so calibration jobs can run standard enterprise pass/fail thresholds.
Runtime (Jayden Park): Need a small metadata shim from runtime that exposes per-token kernel confidence/approximation flag for streaming outputs; will provide a PoC by 2025-03-10.
Design (Ruth Kim): Dashboard payload must include human-readable breakdowns and a suggested textual summary of regressions for the Console UX; added to scope for release notes.
Security (Daniel Ortiz): Execution sandbox must enforce network isolation and disk quotas. Keep raw example capture disabled by default.
qa_plan: Unit tests for each primitive scorer and end-to-end tests for scorer compositions
PR smoke: run fast-approx scoring on small sample of tasks (10 examples each) for INT8/FP8 kernels
Nightly regression: full MMLU-style runs, ROUGE/BLEU over large validation sets, and code execution checks on a curated set
Randomized stability tests: rerun same quant profile 10x to measure metric variance and capture stability_tolerance stats
Calibration gate tests: run false-positive/false-negative scenarios to validate gate thresholds and weighting presets
